text:
Kai H: hey team, first week here — trying to follow the FF quickstart but getting a 403 on https://console.staging.redwood when I click Admin. Who do I ask to get staging access?
Lina P: welcome Kai! Staging access is a short infra ticket. Include your Okta ID and manager approval. For toggling flags you also need the ff-operator role.
Kai H: filed REQ-9054 (okta: kai.h@redwood.dev) and attached manager approval. Not sure which exact role name to request — console-admin?
DevEx Bot: Quick tip: request both "console-admin:staging" and "ff-operator" if you need to use the UI to flip flags. If you only need view metrics use "console-view:staging". Docs: https://go/redwood-devex/console-access
Onboard Bot: Also include the flag key(s) you'll touch and a short rollback plan. Suggested test flag: onboarding/kk-test.
Infra Team: We can grant staging-only roles. Kai, granting console-admin:staging & ff-operator for 72 hours now. Use your Okta email to login. We name the entitlement console-admin:staging (not "console-admin-stg").
Kai H: I can open Admin -> Feature Flags now but can't see the onboarding/kk-test in the list. Is there a filter I'm missing?
Lina P: Flags are often organized by team prefix. Try filtering by "onboarding/" or your team name. If it's not there, create a short-lived flag with prefix onboarding/ and tag it with "ephemeral".
Kai H: created onboarding/kk-test-1 (visibility: dev only) and toggled it. To validate I ran: ```bash
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health | jq .status
``` returned "ok".
SRE Team: Good. Two reminders: 1) Staging grants are temporary; we log every entitlement grant in the audit stream. 2) For prod access you need manager + security approval and an access review.
Infra Team: Note for new hires: if you need a service account for automation, request "service-token:staging" separately and don't embed user tokens in shared scripts.
Kai H: confirmed toggle worked and health check is ok. Thanks for the fast help! :party_parrot:
Lina P: Welcome aboard — ping #devex if you want a 10-min FF UI walkthrough.
DevEx Bot: If you want step-by-step FF rollback snippets, see https://go/redwood-devex/ff-playbook or DM @Lina P for a quick screen share.
